-module(bmscl_attestation_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

attestation_verification_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(Dir) ->
         [?_test(verifies_trusted_signature(Dir)),
          ?_test(rejects_manifest_tamper(Dir)),
          ?_test(rejects_admission_tamper(Dir)),
          ?_test(rejects_provenance_tamper(Dir)),
          ?_test(rejects_untrusted_key(Dir)),
          ?_test(rejects_wrong_public_key(Dir))]
     end}.

setup() ->
    {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(crypto),
    Dir = filename:join([tmp_dir(), "bmscl-attestation-eunit-" ++ integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive]))]),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(Dir, "placeholder")),
    Dir.

cleanup(Dir) ->
    _ = os:cmd("rm -rf " ++ shell_quote(Dir)),
    ok.

verifies_trusted_signature(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    ?assertEqual(ok,
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Manifest, Admission, [{KeyId, PublicHex}])).

rejects_manifest_tamper(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    Forged = <<Manifest/binary, " ">>,
    ?assertMatch({error, {attestation_digest_mismatch, manifest_sha256, _, _}},
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Forged, Admission, [{KeyId, PublicHex}])).

rejects_admission_tamper(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    Forged = <<Admission/binary, " ">>,
    ?assertMatch({error, {attestation_digest_mismatch, admission_report_sha256, _, _}},
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Manifest, Forged, [{KeyId, PublicHex}])).

rejects_provenance_tamper(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    ProvenancePath = filename:join(Dir, "provenance.json"),
    {ok, Provenance} = file:read_file(ProvenancePath),
    ok = file:write_file(ProvenancePath, <<Provenance/binary, " ">>),
    ?assertMatch({error, {attestation_digest_mismatch, provenance_sha256, _, _}},
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Manifest, Admission, [{KeyId, PublicHex}])).

rejects_untrusted_key(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, _KeyId, _PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    ?assertMatch({error, {untrusted_signing_key, <<"test-key-1">>}},
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Manifest, Admission, [])).

rejects_wrong_public_key(Dir) ->
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, _PublicHex} = write_signed_fixture(Dir),
    {OtherPublic, _OtherPrivate} = crypto:generate_key(eddsa, ed25519),
    OtherHex = lower_hex(OtherPublic),
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_attestation_signature},
        bmscl_attestation:verify_with_keys(Dir, Manifest, Admission, [{KeyId, OtherHex}])).

write_signed_fixture(Dir) ->
    BuildSha = binary:copy(<<"11">>, 32),
    SourceSha = binary:copy(<<"22">>, 32),
    Provenance = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => BuildSha
    }),
    ProvenanceSha = sha256_hex(Provenance),
    Manifest = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => BuildSha,
        <<"provenance_sha256">> => ProvenanceSha
    }),
    Admission = jsx:encode(#{<<"admitted">> => true}),
    KeyId = <<"test-key-1">>,
    ManifestSha = sha256_hex(Manifest),
    AdmissionSha = sha256_hex(Admission),
    Payload = bmscl_attestation:canonical_payload(
        KeyId, ManifestSha, AdmissionSha, ProvenanceSha, BuildSha),
    {PublicKey, PrivateKey} = crypto:generate_key(eddsa, ed25519),
    Signature = crypto:sign(eddsa, none, Payload, [PrivateKey, ed25519]),
    Attestation = #{
        <<"format">> => <<"bmscl-artifact-attestation-v2">>,
        <<"algorithm">> => <<"ed25519">>,
        <<"key_id">> => KeyId,
        <<"manifest_sha256">> => ManifestSha,
        <<"admission_report_sha256">> => AdmissionSha,
        <<"provenance_sha256">> => ProvenanceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => BuildSha,
        <<"signature_hex">> => lower_hex(Signature)
    },
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "provenance.json"), Provenance),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "attestation.json"), jsx:encode(Attestation)),
    {Manifest, Admission, KeyId, lower_hex(PublicKey)}.

sha256_hex(Bytes) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes)).

lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).

tmp_dir() ->
    case os:getenv("TMPDIR") of false -> "/tmp"; V -> V end.

shell_quote(S) ->
    "'" ++ string:replace(S, "'", "'\\''", all) ++ "'".

-module(bmscl_beam_static_limits_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

parses_utf8_atom_chunk_without_loading_module_test() ->
    ?assertEqual({ok, 42}, bmscl_beam_static_limits:atom_count(beam_with_atoms(<<"AtU8">>, 42))).

parses_otp29_long_atom_count_marker_test() ->
    ?assertEqual({ok, 5}, bmscl_beam_static_limits:atom_count(beam_with_signed_atoms(<<"AtU8">>, -5))).

parses_legacy_atom_chunk_test() ->
    ?assertEqual({ok, 7}, bmscl_beam_static_limits:atom_count(beam_with_atoms(<<"Atom">>, 7))).

rejects_malformed_beam_test() ->
    ?assertMatch({error, _}, bmscl_beam_static_limits:atom_count(<<"not-beam">>)).

rejects_per_module_atom_budget_test() ->
    Beam = beam_with_atoms(<<"AtU8">>, 4097),
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, {static_atom_budget_exceeded, module, <<"worker">>, _, 4097, 4096}},
       bmscl_beam_static_limits:verify([{<<"worker">>, "worker.beam", Beam}])).

rejects_per_artifact_atom_budget_test() ->
    Modules = [
        {list_to_binary("m" ++ integer_to_list(N)),
         "module.beam",
         beam_with_atoms(<<"AtU8">>, 4096)}
        || N <- lists:seq(1, 5)
    ],
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, {static_atom_budget_exceeded, artifact, _, 16384}},
       bmscl_beam_static_limits:verify(Modules)).

node_headroom_is_fail_closed_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_beam_static_limits:node_headroom(100, 1000, 600)),
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, {atom_table_headroom_exhausted, 700, 101, 1000, 80}},
       bmscl_beam_static_limits:node_headroom(700, 1000, 101)).

beam_with_atoms(Id, Count) ->
    AtomData = <<Count:32/big-unsigned-integer>>,
    beam_with_atom_data(Id, AtomData).

beam_with_signed_atoms(Id, Count) ->
    AtomData = <<Count:32/big-signed-integer>>,
    beam_with_atom_data(Id, AtomData).

beam_with_atom_data(Id, AtomData) ->
    Chunk = <<Id/binary, (byte_size(AtomData)):32/big-unsigned-integer,
              AtomData/binary>>,
    DeclaredSize = 4 + byte_size(Chunk),
    <<"FOR1", DeclaredSize:32/big-unsigned-integer, "BEAM", Chunk/binary>>.

-module(bmscl_budget_manager_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

platform_wall_cap_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Worker = spawn(fun wait_forever/0),
        try
            Ref = make_ref(),
            CompletionToken = make_ref(),
            ?assertEqual(
                {error, {runtime_limit_exceeds_platform_max,
                         max_wall_ms, 90001, 90000}},
                bmscl_budget_manager:register(
                  Worker, limits(90001), self(), Ref, CompletionToken))
        after
            exit(Worker, kill)
        end
    end).

cooperative_completion_is_single_terminal_reply_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Parent = self(),
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun() ->
            ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
                   self(), limits(50), Parent, Ref, CompletionToken),
            Parent ! {registered, self()},
            receive
                finish ->
                    ok = bmscl_budget_manager:complete(
                           CompletionToken,
                           {ok, done},
                           #{wall_time_ms => 1,
                             reductions => 1,
                             output_bytes => 0,
                             termination_reason => normal})
            end
        end),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        receive {registered, Worker} -> ok after 500 -> ?assert(false) end,
        Worker ! finish,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, {ok, done}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(normal, maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics))
        after 500 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, normal} -> ok after 500 -> ?assert(false) end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, _Result, _Metrics} -> ?assert(false)
        after 75 ->
            ok
        end
    end).

invalid_completion_capability_cannot_cancel_watchdog_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Parent = self(),
        Ref = make_ref(),
        Secret = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun() ->
            receive
                try_forge ->
                    Forged = make_ref(),
                    Parent ! {forged_result,
                              bmscl_budget_manager:complete(
                                Forged,
                                {ok, forged},
                                #{wall_time_ms => 0,
                                  reductions => 0,
                                  output_bytes => 0,
                                  termination_reason => normal})},
                    cpu_loop()
            end
        end),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(15), self(), Ref, Secret),
        Worker ! try_forge,
        receive
            {forged_result, {error, invalid_completion_token}} -> ok
        after 500 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref,
             {error, {budget_exceeded, wall_time}}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(wall_time, maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics))
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok after 1000 -> ?assert(false) end
    end).

only_reply_owner_can_cancel_without_late_terminal_reply_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Parent = self(),
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun() ->
            receive
                try_cancel ->
                    Parent ! {worker_cancel_result,
                              bmscl_budget_manager:cancel(self())},
                    wait_forever()
            end
        end),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(1000), self(), Ref, CompletionToken),
        Worker ! try_cancel,
        receive
            {worker_cancel_result, {error, cancellation_caller_mismatch}} -> ok
        after 500 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_budget_manager:cancel(Worker)),
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok after 500 -> ?assert(false) end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, _Result, _Metrics} -> ?assert(false)
        after 25 ->
            ok
        end,
        ?assertEqual({error, not_registered}, bmscl_budget_manager:cancel(Worker))
    end).

mailbox_pressure_is_killed_before_unbounded_growth_test() ->
    with_manager_env([{max_invocation_mailbox_messages, 3}], fun() ->
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun wait_forever/0),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(1000), self(), Ref, CompletionToken),
        Worker ! junk1,
        Worker ! junk2,
        Worker ! junk3,
        Worker ! junk4,
        Worker ! junk5,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref,
             {error, {budget_exceeded, mailbox}}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(mailbox, maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics)),
                ?assert(maps:get(mailbox_messages, Metrics) > 3)
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok after 1000 -> ?assert(false) end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, _Result, _Metrics} -> ?assert(false)
        after 25 ->
            ok
        end
    end).

retained_refc_binary_is_killed_outside_heap_budget_test() ->
    with_manager_env([
        {max_invocation_refc_binary_bytes, 1024},
        {binary_budget_sample_ms, 1}
    ], fun() ->
        Parent = self(),
        Worker = spawn(fun() ->
            Bin = binary:copy(<<16#A5>>, 4096),
            Parent ! {binary_ready, self()},
            receive
                stop -> byte_size(Bin)
            end
        end),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        receive {binary_ready, Worker} -> ok after 500 -> ?assert(false) end,
        ?assertMatch({binary, [_ | _]}, process_info(Worker, binary)),
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(1000), self(), Ref, CompletionToken),
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref,
             {error, {budget_exceeded, refc_binary_memory}}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(refc_binary_memory,
                             maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics)),
                ?assert(maps:get(refc_binary_bytes, Metrics) >= 4096)
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok after 1000 -> ?assert(false) end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, _Result, _Metrics} -> ?assert(false)
        after 25 ->
            ok
        end
    end).

cpu_loop_is_killed_by_wall_watchdog_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun cpu_loop/0),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(15), self(), Ref, CompletionToken),
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref,
             {error, {budget_exceeded, wall_time}}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(wall_time, maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics))
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive
            {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref, _Result, _Metrics} -> ?assert(false)
        after 25 ->
            ok
        end
    end).

unexpected_actor_death_still_completes_request_test() ->
    with_manager(fun() ->
        Ref = make_ref(),
        CompletionToken = make_ref(),
        Worker = spawn(fun wait_forever/0),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
        ok = bmscl_budget_manager:register(
               Worker, limits(1000), self(), Ref, CompletionToken),
        exit(Worker, kill),
        receive
            {bmscl_invocation, Ref,
             {error, {invocation_down, killed}}, Metrics} ->
                ?assertEqual(unexpected_process_exit,
                             maps:get(termination_reason, Metrics)),
                ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(metrics_incomplete, Metrics))
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok after 1000 -> ?assert(false) end
    end).

with_manager(Fun) ->
    with_manager_env([], Fun).

with_manager_env(Env, Fun) ->
    ?assertEqual(undefined, whereis(bmscl_budget_manager)),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms, 1),
    lists:foreach(
      fun({Key, Value}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value) end,
      Env),
    {ok, Manager} = bmscl_budget_manager:start_link(),
    unlink(Manager),
    try
        Fun()
    after
        catch gen_server:stop(Manager),
        application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms),
        lists:foreach(
          fun({Key, _Value}) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key) end,
          Env)
    end.

limits(WallMs) ->
    #{max_wall_ms => WallMs,
      max_reductions => 1000000000000000,
      max_heap_bytes => 64 * 1024 * 1024,
      max_processes => 1}.

wait_forever() ->
    receive stop -> ok end.

cpu_loop() ->
    cpu_loop().

-module(bmscl_capability_ref_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

token_ref_is_not_the_tenant_capability_token_test() ->
    TokenRef = <<"host-registry-ref-42">>,
    Context0 = context(TokenRef),
    ok = bmscl_capability_scope:install(Context0),
    ok = bmscl_capability_ref:install(Context0),
    AbiContext = Context0#{<<"capability_refs">> => []},
    {ok, {context, {cluster_capability, Token}, _Log, _Deadline}} =
        bmscl_hosted_abi:context(AbiContext),
    ?assert(is_binary(Token)),
    ?assert(Token =/= TokenRef),
    ?assertEqual({ok, TokenRef}, bmscl_capability_ref:resolve(<<"ctx.cluster">>)),
    ?assertMatch({ok, _}, bmscl_hosted_abi:authorize(
        <<"ctx.cluster">>, {cluster_capability, Token})).

capability_ref_state_is_process_local_test() ->
    TokenRef = <<"host-registry-ref-7">>,
    Context0 = context(TokenRef),
    ok = bmscl_capability_ref:install(Context0),
    Parent = self(),
    spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {resolved_ref, bmscl_capability_ref:resolve(<<"ctx.cluster">>)} end),
    receive
        {resolved_ref, Result} ->
            ?assertEqual({error, capability_refs_not_installed}, Result)
    after 1000 ->
        ?assert(false)
    end.

ref_for_unadmitted_capability_is_rejected_test() ->
    Context0 = #{
        <<"admitted_capability_grants">> => core_grants(),
        <<"capability_refs">> => [
            #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.http">>, <<"token_ref">> => <<"forged">>}
        ]
    },
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {capability_ref_not_admitted, <<"ctx.http">>}},
       bmscl_capability_ref:install(Context0)).

duplicate_refs_are_rejected_test() ->
    Context0 = context(<<"ref-a">>),
    [Ref] = maps:get(<<"capability_refs">>, Context0),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, duplicate_capability_refs},
       bmscl_capability_ref:install(
         Context0#{<<"capability_refs">> => [Ref, Ref#{<<"token_ref">> => <<"ref-b">>}]})
    ).

context(TokenRef) ->
    Deadline = erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000,
    #{
        <<"deadline_unix_ms">> => Deadline,
        <<"admitted_capabilities">> => [<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>],
        <<"admitted_capability_grants">> => core_grants(),
        <<"capability_refs">> => [
            #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"token_ref">> => TokenRef}
        ]
    }.

core_grants() ->
    [
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
                <<"application_state">> => false
            }
        },
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
                <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
                <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
                <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
                <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
            }
        }
    ].

-module(bmscl_capability_scope_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

compiler_style_grants_round_trip_exactly_test() ->
    Grants = compiler_grants(),
    ?assertEqual(Grants, bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants(Grants)),
    ?assertEqual(
       [<<"ctx.log">>, <<"ctx.cluster">>],
       bmscl_capability_scope:names(Grants)).

installed_scope_is_available_only_inside_trusted_p3_state_test() ->
    Grants = compiler_grants(),
    Context = #{<<"admitted_capability_grants">> => Grants},
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_capability_scope:install(Context)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, #{
           <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
           <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
           <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
           <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
           <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
       }},
       bmscl_capability_scope:scope(<<"ctx.cluster">>)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, #{
           <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
           <<"application_state">> => false
       }},
       bmscl_capability_scope:scope(<<"ctx.log">>)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, capability_scope_not_admitted},
       bmscl_capability_scope:scope(<<"ctx.http">>)).

ambient_or_mutable_capabilities_are_rejected_test() ->
    lists:foreach(fun({Name, Scope}) ->
        ?assertError(
           {invalid_capability_scope, Name},
           bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
               #{<<"name">> => Name, <<"scope">> => Scope}
           ]))
    end, [
        {<<"ctx.http">>, #{<<"hosts">> => [<<"api.example.com">>]}},
        {<<"ctx.kv">>, #{<<"namespaces">> => [<<"cache">>]}},
        {<<"ctx.databases">>, #{<<"databases">> => [<<"primary">>]}},
        {<<"ctx.queues">>, #{<<"queues">> => [<<"jobs">>]}},
        {<<"ctx.env">>, #{<<"keys">> => [<<"REGION">>]}},
        {<<"ctx.secrets">>, #{<<"keys">> => [<<"API_TOKEN">>]}}
    ]).

cluster_scope_must_be_read_only_test() ->
    Base = #{
        <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
        <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
        <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
        <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
        <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
    },
    ?assertError(
       {badmatch, [<<"GET">>, <<"POST">>]},
       bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
           #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"scope">> => Base#{
               <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"POST">>]
           }}
       ])),
    ?assertError(
       {badmatch, 1},
       bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
           #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"scope">> => Base#{
               <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 1
           }}
       ])).

unknown_grant_fields_are_rejected_test() ->
    ?assertError(
       {unknown_capability_grant_keys, [<<"credential">>]},
       bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
           #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>, <<"credential">> => <<"must-never-pass">>}
       ])).

duplicate_grants_are_rejected_test() ->
    Log = #{
        <<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>,
        <<"scope">> => #{
            <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
            <<"application_state">> => false
        }
    },
    ?assertError(
       duplicate_capabilities,
       bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([Log, Log])).

artifact_verification_preserves_exact_scope_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup_artifact_env/0,
     fun cleanup_artifact_env/1,
     fun(Root) ->
         ?_test(begin
             Artifact = make_artifact(Root, compiler_grants()),
             {ok, Spec} = bmscl_artifact:verify(Artifact),
             ?assertEqual(compiler_grants(), maps:get(capabilities, Spec))
         end)
     end}.

setup_artifact_env() ->
    Root = filename:join([tmp_dir(), "bmscl-scope-eunit-" ++ integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive]))]),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(Root, "placeholder")),
    Previous = [
        {require_admission_receipt, application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt)},
        {require_attestation, application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation)},
        {require_trusted_build_provenance, application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance)}
    ],
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, false),
    {Root, Previous}.

cleanup_artifact_env({Root, Previous}) ->
    lists:foreach(fun restore_env/1, Previous),
    _ = os:cmd("rm -rf " ++ shell_quote(Root)),
    ok.

make_artifact({Root, _Previous}, Grants) -> make_artifact(Root, Grants);
make_artifact(Root, Grants) ->
    Dir = filename:join(Root, "artifact"),
    BeamDir = filename:join(Dir, "beam"),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(BeamDir, "placeholder")),
    Forms = [
        {attribute, 1, module, worker},
        {attribute, 1, export, [{handle, 2}]},
        {function, 1, handle, 2,
         [{clause, 1, [{var, 1, '_Req'}, {var, 1, '_Ctx'}], [], [{atom, 1, ok}]}]}
    ],
    {ok, worker, Beam} = compile:forms(Forms, [binary]),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(BeamDir, "worker.beam"), Beam),
    Build = build_digest([{<<"worker">>, Beam}]),
    SourceSha = sha256_hex(<<"scope-test">>),
    Provenance = #{
        <<"format">> => <<"bmscl-build-provenance-v1">>,
        <<"builder_id">> => <<"scope-test-builder">>,
        <<"builder_image_digest">> =>
            <<"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
        <<"compiler_version">> => <<"0.1.0">>,
        <<"compiler_revision">> => <<"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567">>,
        <<"gleam_version">> => <<"1.18.1">>,
        <<"otp_release">> => <<"29">>,
        <<"erts_version">> => <<"17.1">>,
        <<"policy_sha256">> =>
            <<"bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb">>,
        <<"dependency_lock_sha256">> => null,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => Build
    },
    ProvenanceBytes = jsx:encode(Provenance),
    Limits = #{
        <<"max_wall_ms">> => 1000,
        <<"max_reductions">> => 1000000,
        <<"max_heap_bytes">> => 67108864,
        <<"max_processes">> => 1
    },
    Manifest = #{
        <<"format_version">> => 2,
        <<"runtime">> => <<"beam">>,
        <<"language">> => <<"gleam">>,
        <<"profile">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => Build,
        <<"provenance_sha256">> => sha256_hex(ProvenanceBytes),
        <<"entrypoint">> => <<"worker:handle/2">>,
        <<"capabilities">> => Grants,
        <<"runtime_limits">> => Limits
    },
    Admission = #{
        <<"admitted">> => true,
        <<"policy_version">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"runtime_limits">> => Limits
    },
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "manifest.json"), jsx:encode(Manifest)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "admission-report.json"), jsx:encode(Admission)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "provenance.json"), ProvenanceBytes),
    Dir.

compiler_grants() ->
    [
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
                <<"application_state">> => false
            }
        },
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
                <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
                <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
                <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
                <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
            }
        }
    ].

build_digest(ModuleBins) ->
    Ctx0 = crypto:hash_init(sha256),
    Ctx = lists:foldl(fun({Name, Bin}, C0) ->
        C1 = crypto:hash_update(C0, <<Name/binary, ".beam">>),
        C2 = crypto:hash_update(C1, <<0>>),
        C3 = crypto:hash_update(C2, Bin),
        crypto:hash_update(C3, <<0>>)
    end, Ctx0, lists:sort(ModuleBins)),
    lower_hex(crypto:hash_final(Ctx)).

sha256_hex(Bin) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bin)).

lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).

restore_env({Key, undefined}) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key);
restore_env({Key, {ok, Value}}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value).

tmp_dir() ->
    case os:getenv("TMPDIR") of false -> "/tmp"; V -> V end.

shell_quote(S) ->
    "'" ++ string:replace(S, "'", "'\\''", all) ++ "'".

restart_preserves_lease_and_fences_old_owner_test() ->

    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module, bmscl_test_durable_store),
    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, critical_section_max_lease_ms, 5000),

    {ok, Loaded1} = bmscl_critical_section_store:claim_and_load(
                      <<"tenant-a">>, <<"orders">>, <<"lock-1">>),
    ?assertEqual(1, maps:get(owner_epoch, Loaded1)),
    ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(version, Loaded1)),

    {ok, Pid1} = bmscl_critical_section_actor:start(100, Loaded1),
    {ok, Grant1} = bmscl_critical_section_actor:acquire(
                     Pid1, <<"holder-a">>, 1000),

                      <<"tenant-a">>, <<"orders">>, <<"lock-1">>),

state_commit_is_fenced_after_ownership_transfer_test() ->
    bmscl_durable_test_store:reset(),
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module),
    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module, bmscl_durable_test_store),
    Target = target(),
    {ok, Placement} = bmscl_durable_shard:placement(
                        Target, <<"tenant-a">>, <<"chat">>, <<"room-fenced">>),
    try
        {ok, OldPid} = bmscl_durable_actor:start(Placement),
        try
            {ok, OldTurn} = bmscl_durable_actor:admit_turn(OldPid, Placement),
            ?assertEqual(1, maps:get(owner_epoch, OldTurn)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, not_found},
               bmscl_durable_actor:load_state(OldPid, Placement, OldTurn)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, 1},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 OldPid, Placement, OldTurn, 0, <<"v1">>)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, #{version => 1, state => <<"v1">>}},
               bmscl_durable_actor:load_state(OldPid, Placement, OldTurn)),

            %% A different owner is assigned while the old actor is still alive.
            %% The old process still has epoch 1 cached, but the durable store is
            %% now authoritative at epoch 2 and must reject the stale writer.
            {ok, 2} = bmscl_durable_test_store:claim_owner(owner_scope(Placement)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {error, {stale_owner_epoch, 2}},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 OldPid, Placement, OldTurn, 1, <<"stale">>))
        after
            gen_server:stop(OldPid)
        end,

        %% A replacement actor claims the next authoritative epoch and resumes
        %% from the already committed object version.
        {ok, NewPid} = bmscl_durable_actor:start(Placement),
        try
            {ok, NewTurn} = bmscl_durable_actor:admit_turn(NewPid, Placement),
            ?assertEqual(3, maps:get(owner_epoch, NewTurn)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, #{version => 1, state => <<"v1">>}},
               bmscl_durable_actor:load_state(NewPid, Placement, NewTurn)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, 2},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 NewPid, Placement, NewTurn, 1, <<"v2">>)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, #{version => 2, state => <<"v2">>}},
               bmscl_durable_actor:load_state(NewPid, Placement, NewTurn))
        after
            gen_server:stop(NewPid)
        end
    after
        restore_env(durable_store_module, Previous),
        bmscl_durable_test_store:reset()
    end.

older_turn_token_cannot_commit_after_newer_turn_test() ->
    bmscl_durable_test_store:reset(),
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module),
    application:set_env(

            {ok, T2} = bmscl_durable_actor:admit_turn(Pid, Placement),
            ?assertEqual(
               {error, stale_or_invalid_turn_token},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 Pid, Placement, T1, 0, <<"late">>)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {ok, 1},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 Pid, Placement, T2, 0, <<"current">>))
        after
            gen_server:stop(Pid)
        end
    after
        restore_env(durable_store_module, Previous),
        bmscl_durable_test_store:reset()
    end.

forged_turn_token_cannot_load_or_commit_test() ->
    bmscl_durable_test_store:reset(),
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module),
    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, durable_store_module, bmscl_durable_test_store),
    Target = target(),
    {ok, Placement} = bmscl_durable_shard:placement(
                        Target, <<"tenant-a">>, <<"chat">>, <<"room-forged">>),
    try
        {ok, Pid} = bmscl_durable_actor:start(Placement),
        try
            {ok, Turn} = bmscl_durable_actor:admit_turn(Pid, Placement),
            Forged = Turn#{owner_epoch => maps:get(owner_epoch, Turn) + 1},
            ?assertEqual(
               {error, stale_or_invalid_turn_token},
               bmscl_durable_actor:load_state(Pid, Placement, Forged)),
            ?assertEqual(
               {error, stale_or_invalid_turn_token},
               bmscl_durable_actor:commit_state(
                 Pid, Placement, Forged, 0, <<"forged">>))
        after
            gen_server:stop(Pid)
        end
    after
        restore_env(durable_store_module, Previous),
        bmscl_durable_test_store:reset()
    end.

owner_scope(Placement) ->
    #{
        tenant_id => maps:get(tenant_id, Placement),
        application_id => maps:get(application_id, Placement),
        namespace => maps:get(namespace, Placement),
        virtual_shard => maps:get(virtual_shard, Placement)
    }.

restore_env(Key, {ok, Value}) ->
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value);
restore_env(Key, undefined) ->
    application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key).

target() ->
    #{
        execution_class => durable_actor,
        experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
        protocol => http,
        namespace => <<"rooms">>,
        virtual_shards => 4096,
        shards_per_actor => 64,
        deployment_id => <<"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>
    }.

-module(bmscl_durable_test_store).
-behaviour(bmscl_durable_store).

-export([
    reset/0,
    load/2,
    claim_owner/1,
    current_owner_epoch/1,
    commit/5,
    load_handoff/1,
    commit_handoff/3,
    cutover_handoff/3
]).

-define(TABLE, bmscl_durable_test_store_table).

reset() ->
    case ets:whereis(?TABLE) of
        undefined ->
            ok;
        _ ->
            ets:delete(?TABLE)
    end,
    _ = ets:new(
          ?TABLE,
          [named_table, public, set,
           {read_concurrency, true}, {write_concurrency, true}]),
    ok.

load(Identity, _OwnerScope) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {object, Identity}) of
        [] ->
            {ok, not_found};
        [{{object, Identity}, Version, State}] ->
            {ok, #{version => Version, state => State}}
    end.

claim_owner(OwnerScope) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    Epoch = ets:update_counter(
              Tab,
              {owner, OwnerScope},
              {2, 1},
              {{owner, OwnerScope}, 0}),
    {ok, Epoch}.

current_owner_epoch(OwnerScope) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {owner, OwnerScope}) of
        [] ->
            {ok, not_found};
        [{{owner, OwnerScope}, Epoch}] ->
            {ok, Epoch}
    end.

commit(Identity, ExpectedVersion, OwnerScope, OwnerEpoch, Payload)
  when is_integer(ExpectedVersion), ExpectedVersion >= 0,
       is_integer(OwnerEpoch), OwnerEpoch > 0,
       is_binary(Payload) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {owner, OwnerScope}) of
        [] ->
            {error, owner_missing};
        [{{owner, OwnerScope}, CurrentOwner}] when CurrentOwner =/= OwnerEpoch ->
            {error, {stale_owner_epoch, CurrentOwner}};
        [{{owner, OwnerScope}, OwnerEpoch}] ->
            CurrentVersion = object_version(Tab, Identity),
            case CurrentVersion =:= ExpectedVersion of
                false ->
                    {error, {stale_version, CurrentVersion}};
                true ->
                    Next = CurrentVersion + 1,
                    true = ets:insert(Tab, {{object, Identity}, Next, Payload}),
                    {ok, Next}
            end
    end;
commit(_, _, _, _, _) ->
    {error, invalid_durable_commit}.

load_handoff(OwnerScope) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {handoff, OwnerScope}) of
        [] ->
            {ok, not_found};
        [{{handoff, OwnerScope}, Version, Payload}] ->
            {ok, #{version => Version, state => Payload}}
    end.

commit_handoff(OwnerScope, ExpectedVersion, Payload)
  when is_integer(ExpectedVersion), ExpectedVersion >= 0,
       is_binary(Payload) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    global:trans(
      {?MODULE, OwnerScope},
      fun() ->
          CurrentVersion = handoff_version(Tab, OwnerScope),
          case CurrentVersion =:= ExpectedVersion of
              false ->
                  {error, {stale_handoff_version, CurrentVersion}};
              true ->
                  Next = CurrentVersion + 1,
                  true = ets:insert(
                           Tab,
                           {{handoff, OwnerScope}, Next, Payload}),
                  {ok, Next}
          end
      end);
commit_handoff(_, _, _) ->
    {error, invalid_handoff_commit}.

cutover_handoff(OwnerScope, ExpectedVersion, Payload)
  when is_integer(ExpectedVersion), ExpectedVersion >= 0,
       is_binary(Payload) ->
    Tab = ensure_table(),
    global:trans(
      {?MODULE, OwnerScope},
      fun() ->
          CurrentVersion = handoff_version(Tab, OwnerScope),
          case CurrentVersion =:= ExpectedVersion of
              false ->
                  {error, {stale_handoff_version, CurrentVersion}};
              true ->
                  Next = CurrentVersion + 1,
                  Epoch = ets:update_counter(
                            Tab,
                            {owner, OwnerScope},
                            {2, 1},
                            {{owner, OwnerScope}, 0}),
                  true = ets:insert(
                           Tab,
                           {{handoff, OwnerScope}, Next, Payload}),
                  {ok, #{version => Next, owner_epoch => Epoch}}
          end
      end);
cutover_handoff(_, _, _) ->
    {error, invalid_handoff_cutover}.

object_version(Tab, Identity) ->
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {object, Identity}) of
        [] ->
            0;
        [{{object, Identity}, Version, _}] ->
            Version
    end.

handoff_version(Tab, OwnerScope) ->
    case ets:lookup(Tab, {handoff, OwnerScope}) of
        [] ->
            0;
        [{{handoff, OwnerScope}, Version, _}] ->
            Version
    end.

ensure_table() ->
    case ets:whereis(?TABLE) of
        undefined ->
            try ets:new(
                  ?TABLE,
                  [named_table, public, set,
                   {read_concurrency, true}, {write_concurrency, true}]) of
                Tab ->
                    Tab
            catch
                error:badarg ->
                    ?TABLE
            end;
        Tab ->
            Tab
    end.

-module(bmscl_env_cache_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

exact_version_lookup_and_current_pointer_test() ->
    with_cache(fun() ->
        Tenant = <<"tenant-1">>,
        V41 = #{<<"API_URL">> => <<"https://v41.example">>},
        V42 = #{<<"API_URL">> => <<"https://v42.example">>},
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_env_cache:put_snapshot(Tenant, 41, V41)),
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_env_cache:put_snapshot(Tenant, 42, V42)),
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_env_cache:set_current(Tenant, 42)),
        ?assertEqual({ok, 42}, bmscl_env_cache:current_version(Tenant)),
        ?assertEqual({ok, V41}, bmscl_env_cache:require_snapshot(Tenant, 41)),
        ?assertEqual({ok, V42}, bmscl_env_cache:require_snapshot(Tenant, 42))
    end).

missing_version_fails_closed_test() ->
    with_cache(fun() ->
        Tenant = <<"tenant-2">>,
        ?assertEqual(
            {error, {env_version_unavailable, Tenant, 99}},
            bmscl_env_cache:require_snapshot(Tenant, 99)
        ),
        ?assertEqual(
            {error, {env_version_unavailable, Tenant, 99}},
            bmscl_env_cache:set_current(Tenant, 99)
        )
    end).

version_is_immutable_test() ->
    with_cache(fun() ->
        Tenant = <<"tenant-3">>,
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_env_cache:put_snapshot(Tenant, 7, #{<<"A">> => <<"one">>})),
        ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_env_cache:put_snapshot(Tenant, 7, #{<<"A">> => <<"one">>})),
        ?assertEqual(
            {error, {env_version_conflict, Tenant, 7}},
            bmscl_env_cache:put_snapshot(Tenant, 7, #{<<"A">> => <<"two">>})
        )
    end).

with_cache(Fun) ->
    stop_existing(),
    {ok, Pid} = bmscl_env_cache:start_link(),
    unlink(Pid),
    try Fun()
    after
        gen_server:stop(Pid)
    end.

stop_existing() ->
    case whereis(bmscl_env_cache) of
        undefined -> ok;
        Pid ->
            gen_server:stop(Pid),
            ok
    end.

-module(bmscl_execution_boundary_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

legacy_routes_remain_local_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(local_bare_process,
                 bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{deployment_id => <<"dep">>})).

explicit_bare_process_remains_local_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(local_bare_process,
                 bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{isolation_class => bare_process})).

firecracker_routes_are_external_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(firecracker,
                 bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{isolation_class => firecracker})).

experimental_profiles_are_firecracker_only_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {experimental_profile_requires_firecracker,
                phoenix_v1, bare_process}},
       bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{
           experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
           execution_class => request,
           protocol => http,
           isolation_class => bare_process
       })),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {experimental_profile_requires_firecracker,
                durable_actor_v1, bare_process}},
       bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{
           experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
           execution_class => durable_actor,
           protocol => http,
           namespace => <<"rooms">>,
           isolation_class => bare_process
       })).

unknown_profile_fails_closed_test() ->
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, {invalid_faas_profile_value, experimental_profile, _}},
       bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{
           experimental_profile => unknown_profile,
           isolation_class => firecracker
       })).

invalid_isolation_class_fails_closed_test() ->
    ?assertEqual({error, {invalid_isolation_class, container}},
                 bmscl_execution_boundary:classify(#{isolation_class => container})).

-module(bmscl_execution_policy_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

standard_faas_authority_is_minimal_test() ->
    {ok, Policy} = bmscl_execution_policy:authority(#{}),
    ?assertEqual(bare_process, maps:get(backend, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(beam_process_spawn, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(os_process_spawn, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(filesystem, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(native_code, Policy)).

phoenix_authority_is_microvm_scoped_test() ->
    {ok, Policy} = bmscl_execution_policy:authority(#{
        experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
        isolation_class => firecracker
    }),
    ?assertEqual(firecracker, maps:get(backend, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(single_tenant_microvm, maps:get(tenant_isolation, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(allowed, maps:get(beam_process_spawn, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(os_process_spawn, Policy)),
    Fs = maps:get(filesystem, Policy),
    ?assertEqual(read_only, maps:get(release, Fs)),
    ?assertEqual(writable_quota, maps:get(tmp, Fs)),
    ?assertEqual(capability_only, maps:get(persistent, Fs)).

durable_actor_keeps_spawn_platform_managed_test() ->
    {ok, Policy} = bmscl_execution_policy:authority(#{
        experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
        isolation_class => firecracker
    }),
    ?assertEqual(firecracker, maps:get(backend, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(platform_managed, maps:get(beam_process_spawn, Policy)),
    ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(os_process_spawn, Policy)).

worker_admission_requires_exact_backend_test() ->
    Phoenix = #{
        experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
        isolation_class => firecracker
    },
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_execution_policy:admit_worker(Phoenix, firecracker)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {execution_backend_mismatch, firecracker, bare_process}},
       bmscl_execution_policy:admit_worker(Phoenix, bare_process)),
    ?assertEqual(
       ok,
       bmscl_execution_policy:admit_worker(#{}, <<"bare_process">>)).

-module(bmscl_experimental_runtime_test_dispatcher).

-export([invoke_async/3, register_connection/3, locate_durable_actor/4]).

invoke_async(Target, Request, Context) ->
    {ok, {external_invoke, Target, Request, Context}}.

register_connection(Target, TransportPid, Context) ->
    {ok, {external_connection, Target, TransportPid, Context}}.

locate_durable_actor(Target, TenantId, ApplicationId, ObjectKey) ->
    {ok, {external_durable, Target, TenantId, ApplicationId, ObjectKey}}.
